title: StripePortal
description: supabase/functions/stripe-portal/index.ts. Authenticated. Creates a Stripe Billing Portal session so a paid user can update payment method or cancel. The Stripe customer id is looked up server-side from the caller's own profiles.stripe_customer_id (never trusted from the client) — if there is no customer id yet (never checked out), returns 400 no_subscription. Request body is empty (no fields) — the function reads only the JWT.

error.description: unauthenticated, no_subscription (no Stripe customer on file yet), or Stripe's own session.error.message on a Stripe API failure.
